text: Hi, if you're wantin' a job on a caravan, you should talk to Rutger.  He's just over there.

text: So you signed up.  Good to hear it.  So ya know, we leave just about every ten days. That's the 8th, 18th, and 28th of each month.  Right now we're making runs to The Brotherhood, Junktown and the LA Boneyard.

text: You'll get 400 hubbucks. You might be sayin' that it ain't that much, but we go out often and you ain't gonna lose your life that easy.  But you get that pay going each way, not that you have to go each way, but you'll get a total of 800 if you do.
